cards.title: Pickup & Delivery

cards.title: 21+ Only

faqs.question: Do I need to be 21 to shop at Canna Blooms?
faqs.answer: Yes. Canna Blooms is a recreational dispensary and New York State law requires all customers to be 21 years of age or older with valid government-issued photo ID.

faqs.question: What ID is required?
faqs.answer: A valid, government-issued photo ID showing you are 21 or older — such as a driver's license, state ID or passport — is required for every visit, pickup and delivery.

faqs.question: What areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: Canna Blooms operates three New York locations — Farmingville, Queens and Vestal — each serving its surrounding neighborhoods. See the Neighborhoods We Serve section for details, or contact your nearest store.

faqs.question: What are your store hours?
faqs.answer: Farmingville and Queens are open Monday through Thrusday, 09AM-12AM. Queens are open Monday through Thrusday, 09AM-11PM. Vestal is open Monday through Saturday, 09AM-12PM. Please call your nearest store to confirm Saturday-Sunday and holiday hours.

faqs.question: Can I order ahead for pickup?
faqs.answer: Where available, you can browse Canna Blooms' online menu and place an order ahead of your visit. Contact your nearest store for current ordering options.

faqs.question: Is Canna Blooms a licensed dispensary?
faqs.answer: Yes. Canna Blooms operates as a New York State licensed cannabis retailer across all of its locations.
